(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer, each layer having a substantially uniform thickness; and an additional adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of a medial section, and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 281 wherein the ring includes __a__ central opening.
